title: The Great Migrations - A népvándorlás kora

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain what the népvándorlás (Migration Period) was.
I can name the main peoples who moved through or settled in the Carpathian Basin during the Migration Period: the Huns, Goths, Avars and Slavs.
I can describe the rise and fall of the Hun and Avar powers in the basin.
I can use míg to describe two things happening at the same time.
I can explain that the Avars and Slavic peoples coexisted in different parts of the basin at the same time.
